result:
The kanban board is built in `board/` (`index.html`, `style.css`, `app.js`), and I committed it as `0cb1bb3`. Open `board/index.html` in a browser to use it.

I ran one headless-Chrome smoke test. It covered add card, open the editor, save, undo, and search filtering, and all of those worked. I did not test drag-and-drop, import/export, label management, the archive screen or multiple tabs. I also haven't tried it in Safari or Firefox, or on a touch screen.

- **Boards:** you can have several boards. Each has its own columns, labels and archive.
- **Columns:** add, rename, reorder (drag the header or use the menu), and set a WIP limit. The count turns red when you go over the limit. You can also mark a column as "done". Cards in it show struck through and record a completion time.
- **Cards:**
  - Each card has a title, description, labels, priority and due date.
  - Cards also have a checklist, with progress shown on the card.
  - Due dates show amber when close and red when overdue.
  - Drag cards between and within columns.
  - Add cards quickly from the "+ Add card" box under each column. It stays open so you can type several in a row.
- **Finding things:** the search box matches titles, descriptions, checklist items and label names, and a label dropdown filters further.
- **Archive:** archived cards can be restored or deleted. Deleting a column archives its cards rather than destroying them.
- **Undo:** undo and redo cover every change, and destructive actions show an "Undo" toast.
- **Saving:** everything saves automatically in the browser (localStorage), so it stays on that browser on that device. Several open tabs stay in sync.
- **Backup:** "Export backup" in the ☰ menu downloads a JSON file, and import restores it. This is the only way to move your data to another device, so export one now and then.
- **Keyboard:** `n` adds a card, `/` focuses search, and `?` shows the shortcut list. With a card focused, Alt+arrows move it, Delete archives it, and Enter opens it.
- **Theme:** light, dark, or follow the system.

Drag-and-drop uses the browser's built-in dragging, which generally doesn't work on touch screens. On a phone, use the "Column" dropdown in the card editor to move a card.
